chunks: It will only be a single blast,

key_terms.زَجْرَةٌ: A shout, blast, or call to gather

ai.seo_question: How quickly will the Day of Resurrection occur according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this 'single shout' (zajratan wahidatan) is often interpreted as the command of the Archangel Israfil or the divine decree that instantly transitions creation from death to life, highlighting the absolute power of Allah. This immediacy underscores the concept of *Barzakh* being brief and the sudden awakening for judgment, a theme frequently linked to the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt in executing divine will. The verse serves as a reminder of the unpredictability of the Hour, urging believers to maintain constant spiritual readiness.
